legacy_reference_note: NBC 2016 Part 4 is retained as a secondary/legacy reference for buildings designed, approved, or last certified under the earlier code and not yet reassessed. Retrieval should default to 2026 unless the case file indicates a 2016-certified building.

known_source_document_inconsistency.topic: Group H / Group J occupancy labeling
known_source_document_inconsistency.issue: Clause 3.1.1 general summary list states 'Group H: Hazardous, Group J: Storage'. The detailed defining clauses (3.1.9 and 3.1.10) state the opposite: 'Group H: Storage Buildings' and 'Group J: Hazardous Buildings'. This is also consistent with the unchanged 2016 definitions and with Table 7H (titled 'Storage Buildings') / Table 7J (titled 'Hazardous Buildings').
known_source_document_inconsistency.resolution: H = Storage, J = Hazardous. Ingestion/classification logic MUST key off the detailed clauses (3.1.9, 3.1.10) and the Table 7H/7J titles, never off the 3.1.1 summary list.
known_source_document_inconsistency.verified_by: Direct read of source document, clauses 3.1.1, 3.1.9, 3.1.10, and Table 7H/7J titles.
